title: TSL-phosphorylated SGS3 shifts RDR6 from terminal nucleotidyltransferase to polymerase activity to promote RNAi and immunity.
abstract: RNA-dependent RNA polymerase 6 (RDR6) and suppressor of gene silencing 3 (SGS3) form small interfering RNA (siRNA) bodies to synthesize double-stranded RNA, triggering RNA interference. Like viral RDRs, RDR6 not only has polymerase action but also has terminal nucleotidyltransferase activity that tails single-stranded RNA templates, causing their degradation. How the dual activities are controlled is unknown. Here we discovered that Arabidopsis Tousled (TSL) predominantly phosphorylates Ser65 and Ser68, located in the intrinsically disordered region of SGS3, to promote RNA interference. SGS3 phosphomimics trigger the formation of liquid-like siRNA bodies but have lower RNA-binding affinity, thereby enhancing RDR6 polymerase activity to synthesize double-stranded RNA for downstream processing by Dicer-like 2/4. Conversely, hypo-phosphorylated SGS3 forms larger and solid-like aggregates that hold RNA templates with stronger affinity, thereby prompting RDR6 terminal nucleotidyltransferase activity. Moreover, viral infection drives SGS3 hypo-phosphorylation and aggregation, suppressing viral siRNA production and host defence. Collectively, stoichiometric phosphorylation of SGS3 switches two distinct activities of RDR6 to tune RNA silencing and host anti-viral immunity.

summary.title_zh: TSL磷酸化SGS3使RDR6从末端核苷酸转移酶活性转变为聚合酶活性以促进RNAi和免疫
summary.enzyme_type: RDR6（RNA依赖的RNA聚合酶6）与SGS3（基因沉默抑制因子3）组成的siRNA体系统，下游由Dicer-like 2/4加工；不涉及RNase III家族成员本身，但属于dsRNA合成与RNAi调控通路
summary.mechanism: TSL激酶主要磷酸化SGS3内在无序区的Ser65和Ser68，磷酸化模拟型SGS3降低RNA结合亲和力但促进液状siRNA体形成，从而增强RDR6聚合酶活性合成dsRNA供DCL2/4加工；低磷酸化SGS3则形成更大更固态的聚集体，以更高亲和力结合RNA模板，促使RDR6转向末端核苷酸转移酶活性给单链RNA加尾导致降解。病毒侵染驱动SGS3低磷酸化与聚集，抑制病毒siRNA产生和宿主防御，因此SGS3的化学计量磷酸化作为开关切换RDR6的两种活性以调节RNA沉默和抗病毒免疫。
summary.engineering: 涉及蛋白磷酸化位点（Ser65/Ser68）的突变设计（磷酸化模拟/低磷酸化模拟）以重编程RDR6活性平衡；未涉及结构域融合或可编程RNA切割；对RNAi效率调控和抗病毒育种具有潜在生物技术应用价值
summary.key_results: 鉴定TSL磷酸化SGS3的Ser65/Ser68位点；磷酸化模拟型SGS3形成液状siRNA体、降低RNA结合力并增强RDR6聚合酶活性产生dsRNA；低磷酸化SGS3形成固态聚集体、增强RNA结合并促进RDR6末端核苷酸转移酶活性；病毒侵染诱导SGS3低磷酸化聚集从而抑制病毒siRNA和宿主防御。
